tools.name: external_cycle_action
tools.description: Claim an explicitly user-authorized role handoff, read its pinned inputs, publish/submit the assigned output or report its first failure. Does not spawn an Agent or grant human approval. Uses this MCP process identity; configure RESEARCH_AGENT_ID outside tool arguments for reconnects.
